# Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 1, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how LoroHub LLC ("Lody", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses,
stores, and protects information when you use our Services.

## 1. Data Controller and Contact

- Company: LoroHub LLC
- Email: contact@lody.ai

## 2. Information We Collect

Based on current product behavior, we collect the following categories of data:

### 2.1 Account and Authentication Data

- GitHub third-party login information (such as account identifier, profile basics, and email
  available from GitHub)

### 2.2 Device and Technical Data

- Device platform and operating system information
- Basic technical diagnostics and usage metadata

### 2.3 Service Logs

- Operational logs and security logs needed to run, debug, and secure the Services

### 2.4 User Content

- Conversation content and related workflow context you submit through the Services

## 3. How We Use Information

We use information to:

- Authenticate users and protect account security
- Provide core collaboration and code workflow features
- Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve the Services
- Measure product usage and performance
- Detect abuse, prevent attacks, and enforce Terms
- Comply with legal obligations

## 4. Third-Party Services and Processing

We use trusted service providers to run parts of the Services:

- Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare R2 (hosting and storage)
- Convex (backend infrastructure)
- GitHub (third-party login integration)
- Google Analytics (website analytics)
- PostHog (product analytics)
- Sentry (error monitoring)

These providers process data under their own terms and privacy policies.

## 5. Cross-Border Transfer

Under current operations, we do not intentionally transfer your personal data across borders.
If this changes, we will update this policy and implement appropriate safeguards.

## 6. Data Retention

- Data is stored until you request deletion or as needed for operational/legal purposes.
- You may request data export and account/data deletion.
- After deletion is requested and confirmed, data is permanently cleared within 30 days.

## 7. Your Choices and Rights

You can:

- Request a copy/export of your data
- Request deletion of your data
- Contact us to request corrections where applicable

To make a request, use the [Account and Data Deletion page](/account-deletion) or email
contact@lody.ai.

## 8. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect information.
No system is perfectly secure, but we work to reduce risk and respond to incidents promptly.

## 9. Children and Minors

The Services are available to both individual and business users and do not set a fixed minimum
age in this policy.
If local law requires guardian consent for minors, users are responsible for ensuring valid consent
before use.

## 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
When we make material changes, we will update the "Last updated" date and may provide additional
notice.

## 11. Contact

For privacy requests or questions, contact: contact@lody.ai
